Commit a deterministic reproduction script as flaky-orders/repro.mjs that prints RACE REPRODUCED and exits with status 0 exactly when it demonstrates the oversell on the unmodified source. This mission is a diagnosis — do not repair or modify the source.

Success criteria: A diagnosis is stated with supporting evidence. | The root cause is identified or explicitly ruled out with evidence.
